372  def __set_max_velocity_scaling_percentage(self, percentage):
373  """
374  Ask MoveIt to set the relative speed to (percentage)%
375  :param percentage:
376  :return: None
377  """
378  self.__max_velocity_scaling_percentage = percentage
379  self.__velocity_scaling_factor = (percentage / self.__velocity_percentage_scaling_factor)
380  self.__arm.set_max_velocity_scaling_factor(self.__velocity_scaling_factor)
381  self.__publish_velocity_scaling_percentage()
382 
383  def __set_max_acceleration_scaling_percentage(self, percentage):
384  """
385  Ask MoveIt to set the relative acceleration to (percentage)%
386  :param percentage:
387  :return: None
388  """
389  self.__max_acceleration_scaling_percentage = percentage
390  self.__acceleration_scaling_factor = (percentage / self.__acceleration_percentage_scaling_factor)
391  self.__arm.set_max_acceleration_scaling_factor(self.__acceleration_scaling_factor)
392  self.__publish_acceleration_scaling_percentage()
